tldr: North Node in capricorn: growth through maturity, structure, public contribution, and self-respect.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop maturity, structure, public contribution, and self-respect. The South Node in cancer shows the familiar route: retreating into dependency, mood, family scripts, or protection that keeps life small. The work is not to reject the South Node completely, but to stop letting it run automatically. The North Node becomes stronger through repeated, conscious choices to take responsibility without abandoning tenderness.
business: Growth accelerates when the person practices maturity, structure, public contribution, and self-respect in real decisions, relationships, work, and daily habits.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in cancer can pull the person back into retreating into dependency, mood, family scripts, or protection that keeps life small.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node sign names the growth medicine; South Node sign names the familiar pattern. Do not treat either node as a planet or deterministic fate.
note: Distilled from approved project node source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
